question: Who among the following is the author of "Flood of Fire"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitav Ghosh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitav Ghosh** is the author of **"Flood of Fire,**" which is the **third book** in his** Ibis Trilogy.**
 
• The Ibis Trilogy is a historical fiction series that follows the** opium trade** between **India and China** in the **19th century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunima Sinha** is the** first female amputee** to climb Mount Everest.
 
• **Tarun Khanna** is a **Harvard Business School professor and author.**
 
• **Twinkle Khanna **is an **Indian actress and author.**
